description: Prolonged dry spell over past 6 weeks. Borewell water tables dropped by 4.2m bgl.
recommendedAction: Enforce emergency water rationing for irrigation; supply drinking water through tankers; activate PMKSY drip subsidy.

description: Reservoir levels below 30% storage capacity. Palar river sub-surface extraction under restriction.
recommendedAction: Encourage cultivation of short-duration millets and pulses; restrict daylight flood irrigation.

description: Saline ingress risk due to heavy groundwater extraction. Water table critical.
recommendedAction: Subsidized distribution of salt-tolerant crop seeds; rainwater harvesting structure desilting.

description: Localized dry spell in northern blocks; moderate ground storage.
recommendedAction: Monitor dam outflow from Stanley/Mettur reservoir; promote mulch and micro-irrigation.

description: Adequate canal water supply through Grand Anicut / Cauvery Delta network. Samba crop sowing in progress.
recommendedAction: Maintain routine rotational canal releases and prevent tail-end water wastage.

description: Western Ghat catchment inflows stable; groundwater table requires continuous recharge check.
recommendedAction: Promote drip irrigation for coconut plantations and vegetables.
